data.name: Carthage: Bellum Punicum
data.detailed_description:
Prepare for an immersive wargame experience where every decision and every battle matters. Carthage: Bellum Punicum plunges you into the 3rd century BCE, and into the brutal, world-shaping conflict of the Second Punic War. In this authentic, deep historical strategy game, you command one of the major powers fighting for supremacy.

Will you lead the Carthaginian forces under the legendary Hannibal Barca to crush Rome, defend the Republic alongside heroes like Scipio Africanus, or seize the opportunity as an ambitious third party, waiting for a chance to carve out your own Mediterranean empire?

Inspired by the renowned YouTube channel HistoryMarche, Carthage: Bellum Punicum is crafted with a meticulous focus on historical authenticity and challenging strategic combat. It's time to rewrite the fate of the ancient world.

UNPRECEDENTED HISTORICAL SIMULATION

Carthage: Bellum Punicum is built for true wargame enthusiasts, combining the scale of grand conflict with granular tactical detail:

  • Individual Unit Rendering: Witness the chaos of ancient warfare come alive. Every single soldier, from the hardened Carthaginian veteran to the green Roman recruit, is individually rendered on the battlefield, creating a realistic, dense, and visceral combat simulation.

  • Unique Visual Style: All military units are rendered in a distinctive square formation style, giving the game a unique and visually recognizable presentation.

GRAND CAMPAIGN: A (ANCIENT) WORLD AT WAR

Embark on one of the greatest military sagas in history, blending grand strategy with tactical depth in real time:

  • Dynamic Map & Borders: Experience a real-time campaign where borders are fluid and dynamic, constantly shifting based on conflict and influence. This unique feature allows you to pursue both historical paths and compelling alternative history scenarios across the vast Mediterranean war theater.

  • Strategic & Tactical Blend: Whether commanding Carthage, Rome, or an opportunistic third nation, the campaign features dynamic events where your leadership choices shape the morale, political landscape, and supply health of your army. Successfully managing vulnerable supply lines through treacherous mountains and hostile lands is crucial.

REALISTIC BATTLEFIELD DYNAMICS

Master the challenges of command in the fog of war and the heat of battle through unique & realistic simulation mechanics:

  • Command & Resource Logistics: Issue orders that take time to arrive through messengers. This unique command delay mechanic forces careful pre-planning. Similarly, resources, such as supplies and diplomatic messages, are realistically delayed, as they travel by caravans or ships on the campaign map.

  • Comprehensive Realism Factors: The outcome of every clash is determined by dozens of realistic factors, including morale, stamina, organization, experience, weapon proficiencies, terrain, and weather. Unit stats are dynamically impacted by flanking maneuvers, proximity to commanders, and relative troop numbers.

ICONIC HISTORICAL BATTLES

Relive the legendary, pivotal clashes of the Punic Wars with unparalleled historical precision and detail:

  • Meticulous Battlemaps: Engage in blood-soaked conflicts like Hannibal's magnum opus at Cannae, the ambush at Lake Trasimene, the brutal surprise attack at the Trebia River, or the decisive Battle of Zama. Carthage: Bellum Punicum's battlemaps are crafted and verified using detailed historical sources, ensuring you fight on the exact same ground where history was made.

  • Authentic Ancient Warfare: Command historically accurate unit types, from the disciplined Roman acies triplex formations and heavy legionary infantry to the dreaded Carthaginian elephants, and Iberian mercenary light troops.

CHALLENGING & ADAPTIVE AI

Face an opponent worthy of a strategic genius, designed for a demanding real-time tactics experience:

  • Competent Opposition: The enemy AI is a formidable opponent that actively flanks, employs realistic historical maneuvers, retreats when necessary, and dynamically adapts its strategy based on your moves.

  • Faction-Specific Tactics: The enemy also reflects the unique military doctrines of different historical factions. Clash with the unwavering resilience of the Roman Legions, or face the relentless harassment tactics of the Iberian tribes, ensuring every engagement is demanding and unique.

ATMOSPHERE & IMMERSION

Immerse yourself fully in the world of the Punic Wars through stunning presentation:

  • Original Soundtrack: The game features an original, evocative soundtrack. Battle music dynamically shifts based on the cultural army you are commanding, while the campaign soundtrack changes based on your geographical position on the map, enhancing regional immersion.

  • Beautiful 2D/3D Graphics: Enjoy a simplistic and captivating visual style combining detailed 2D and 3D artwork that brings both the grand campaign map and the intense tactical battles to vivid life.

data.short_description: Lead Hannibal's epic campaign to crush the Roman Republic. Command individually rendered legions, manage complex supply lines, master realistic real-time tactics, and outplay challenging enemies in the Second Punic War to claim your place in history.
